Elementul a fost înscris în 2010 pe List: The element was inscribed in 2010 on the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity; the inscription recognizes cultural value, not clinical efficacy.
Este considerat textul fundamental al me: It is considered the foundational text of traditional Chinese medicine; it was compiled gradually, in the Han era (c. 2nd–1st centuries BCE), from older and newer layers.
Este un ajutor de confort; nu înlocuieșt: It is a comfort aid; it does not replace prescribed medication (asthma, COPD). A cough lasting more than 2–3 weeks, with blood, fever or difficulty breathing requires a consultation.
Evită punctele marcate ⚠ (SP6, LI4, BL60: Avoid the points marked ⚠ (SP6, LI4, BL60, GB21, etc.), the lower abdominal points and the lumbosacral area; moxibustion and electrostimulation are not used; any use only with a doctor/practitioner experienced in pregnancy.
Expirația lungă și relaxarea mușchilor f: A long exhalation and muscle relaxation make the technique more comfortable and easier to tolerate.
Fibre (legume, fructe, cereale integrale: Fiber (vegetables, fruit, whole grains), 1.5–2 liters of fluids a day, daily walking, a regular toilet routine, do not put off the urge to defecate. In pregnancy, omit LI4, SP6 and deep abdominal massage (ST25).
Fă sesiunea cu 30–60 min înainte de somn: Do the session 30–60 min before sleep, in a quiet room; sleep hygiene matters more than the points. Omit SP6 in pregnancy. Insomnia lasting more than 3 weeks, snoring with pauses in breathing, or a depressed mood: ask for a consultation.
Fără ace pe torace/spate/umăr; presiune: No needles on the chest/back/shoulder; gentle pressure.
Fără dovezi consistente de beneficiu sus: No consistent evidence of sustained benefit (6 months
No consistent evidence of sustained benefit (6 months+)
Fără electroacupunctură sau TENS/TEAS; n: No electroacupuncture or TENS/TEAS; current is not passed through the chest, head or neck.
Fără electroacupunctură sau electrostimu: No electroacupuncture or electrostimulation; needles only with the doctor's approval; gentle pressure.
GV26 este pe linia mediană, în filtrum,: GV26 is on the midline, in the philtrum, at the junction of the upper and middle thirds; it is traditionally used in emergency situations.
Genunchiul și zona din jurul rotulei: The knee and the area around the kneecap
Greața postoperatorie, cu PC6 (dovezi de: Postoperative nausea, with PC6 (low to moderate quality evidence)
Greață și rău de mișcare: punctul centra: Nausea and motion sickness: the central point is PC6 (Neiguan), on the inner side of the forearm, three finger-widths above the wrist crease, between the two tendons. In TCM, PC6 "calms the stomach and chest". For PC6 stimulation in nausea after surgery, a Cochrane review (Lee, Chan and Fan, 2015) found low-quality evidence that it is better than placebo and moderate evidence that it does not differ from antiemetic drugs. ST36 and CV12 are sometimes added for digestion. Press PC6 for one minute on each arm, with slow breathing. In pregnancy, ask a doctor first (the evidence for nausea in pregnancy is inconclusive, and CV12 is avoided or used only with a doctor's approval).
Grupul de așteptare este selectat după v: The waiting group is selected by age
Grupul de așteptare nu primește nici ate: The waiting group receives neither attention nor ritual
Grupul de așteptare primește un tratamen: The waiting group receives a stronger treatment
Hidratare, urinare după contact sexual,: Hydration, urinating after sexual intercourse, hygiene, avoiding holding in urine, discussing prophylaxis with the doctor. In pregnancy, omit CV4 (lower abdomen).
Huangdi Neijing (Suwen și Lingshu) este: The Huangdi Neijing (Suwen and Lingshu) is a layered compilation, from the Warring States–Han period (dating disputed), not the work of a single author.
Iată zece puncte frecvent întâlnite, cu: Here are ten commonly encountered points, with simplified location. LI4 (Hegu) is on the back of the hand, at the midpoint of the second metacarpal bone, on the thumb side. In tradition, it is used for the head, face and pain in general; caution in pregnancy. PC6 (Neiguan) is on the inner side of the forearm, 2 cun above the wrist crease, between the tendons; it is the most studied point for nausea; for postoperative nausea, the Cochrane review (2015) found low-quality evidence versus sham and moderate versus antiemetic drugs. ST36 (Zusanli) is 3 cun below ST35, one finger-width lateral to the tibial crest; it is traditionally used for digestion and fatigue.
Insomnie și agitație seara: fă sesiunea: Insomnia and evening restlessness: do the session 30–60 minutes before bedtime, in semi-darkness. HT7, in the wrist crease, on the little-finger side, is the "calming the mind" point in TCM; add KI1, in the sole, and SP6, above the ankle (avoid SP6 in pregnancy). Research on acupressure for sleep exists, but it is small and of variable quality; sleep hygiene remains the foundation. If insomnia lasts more than 3 weeks or snoring with pauses in breathing occurs, ask for a consultation.
Jucărie de dentiție rece (nu înghețată),: A cold (not frozen) teething toy, a clean finger on the gum, hydration, comforting, avoiding benzocaine gels and amber or silicone teething necklaces/bracelets worn on the body (risk of choking and strangulation), discussing age-appropriate analgesics with the pediatrician.
La baza craniului, lateral de ceafă: At the base of the skull, lateral to the nape
La cel puțin 1 oră după masă; masaj circ: At least 1 hour after a meal; light circular massage, clockwise, on the abdomen. Not on the abdomen in pregnancy, after abdominal surgery, or with severe abdominal pain, fever, vomiting or blood in the stool.
La colțul lateral al unghiei degetului I: At the lateral corner of the nail of the fourth finger
La colțul medial al unghiei halucelui: At the medial corner of the nail of the big toe
La colțul radial al unghiei arătătorului: At the radial corner of the nail of the index finger
La creștet, pe linia mediană a capului: At the crown of the head, on the midline of the head
La pliul încheieturii, între cele două t: At the wrist crease, between the two tendons
La tâmplă, lângă unghiul extern al ochiu: At the temple, near the outer corner of the eye
La unghiul mandibulei, pe marginea maset: At the angle of the mandible, on the edge of the masseter
La vârful degetului mic, pe partea ulnar: At the tip of the little finger, on the ulnar side
Laserul poate leza retina; se recomandă: The laser can damage the retina; protective goggles appropriate to the laser class are recommended, for both the patient and the practitioner.
Lungimea mâinii de la încheietură la vâr: The length of the hand from the wrist to the tip
Lățimea a patru degete unite, la falanga: The width of four fingers held together, at the middle phalanx
Manuscrisele de mătase din mormântul Maw: The silk manuscripts from the Mawangdui tomb (sealed in 168 BCE) describe 11 vessels and speak of moxibustion, not needles; the system of 12 meridians appears later, in the Neijing.
Masaj cu jet de apă pe punctele de pe sp: Water-jet massage on the points on the back
Masaj și căldură, întinderi ușoare, încă: Massage and heat, light stretching, suitable footwear, movement during the day, hydration, paracetamol/ibuprofen only on a doctor's recommendation; do not give aspirin to children.
Maximă, mai mare decât a studiilor contr: Maximal, greater than that of controlled studies
Mergi la medic dacă ai sângerări vaginal: See a doctor if you have vaginal bleeding after menopause (mandatory), chest pain, strong palpitations, very low mood, severe hot flashes that affect functioning, unexplained weight loss. Severe chest pain, or chest pain with sweating, shortness of breath or pain radiating to the arm/jaw is an emergency: call 112.
Mergi la medic dacă ai: dificultăți la î: See a doctor if you have: difficulty swallowing, repeated vomiting, black stools or blood in vomit, unexplained weight loss, anemia, pain that wakes you at night, age over 50 with new symptoms, chest pain. Pain in the upper abdomen with sweating, shortness of breath, sudden nausea or pain in the arm/jaw may be a heart attack (in women and diabetics the symptoms are often atypical): call 112. Pain that moves to the lower right, with fever or a rigid abdomen, requires emergency care (appendicitis).
Mergi la medic dacă ai: febră peste 39 °: See a doctor if you have: fever above 39 °C or lasting more than 3 days, difficulty breathing, chest pain, severe sore throat with difficulty swallowing, symptoms that worsen after 7–10 days; in infants under 3 months any fever (38 °C or more) requires urgent medical consultation. Other warning signs: stiff neck, a rash that does not fade on pressure, confusion, excessive drowsiness. Severe chest pain, or chest pain with sweating, shortness of breath or pain radiating to the arm/jaw is an emergency: call 112.
Mergi la medic dacă ai: sânge în scaun,: See a doctor if you have: blood in the stool, black stools, unexplained weight loss, severe abdominal pain with bloating and no passage of gas (possible ileus), age over 50 with a recent change in bowel habits, new and persistent constipation. Emergency: intense and sudden abdominal pain, hard abdomen, vomiting or fever (appendicitis, obstruction, perforation): do not massage the abdomen.
Mergi la medic dacă ai: tuse peste 3 săp: See a doctor if you have: a cough lasting more than 3 weeks, blood in sputum, difficulty breathing, high fever, chest pain, wheezing, cough in an infant or young child with rapid breathing, choking/"barking" cough with stridor, weight loss. Severe chest pain, or chest pain with sweating, is an emergency (112).
Mergi la medic dacă apar: palpitații put: See a doctor if the following occur: strong palpitations with chest pain, fainting, repeated panic attacks, anxiety that prevents you from functioning. Severe chest pain, or chest pain with sweating, shortness of breath or pain radiating to the arm/jaw is an emergency: call 112.
Mergi la medic dacă diareea persistă pes: See a doctor if diarrhea persists for more than 2 days in adults (more than 24 hours in young children and the elderly), you have blood or mucus in the stool, high fever, signs of dehydration (thirst, little urine, dizziness), severe abdominal pain, or are returning from a trip to tropical areas. See a doctor sooner if you are pregnant, elderly, immunocompromised, have recently taken antibiotics or have a chronic illness (diabetes, kidney, heart).
Mergi la medic dacă enurezisul apare bru: See a doctor if bedwetting appears suddenly after a dry period, is accompanied by burning, great thirst, weight loss, daytime urination, severe constipation, snoring or pain; or persists beyond age 7, or affects the child emotionally (shame, isolation).
Mergi la medic dacă febra reapare, tusea: See a doctor if the fever returns, cough or difficulty breathing worsens, fatigue persists beyond 4 weeks, palpitations or chest pain occur, edema, or weight loss. Severe chest pain, or chest pain with sweating, shortness of breath or pain radiating to the arm/jaw is an emergency: call 112.
Mergi la medic dacă genunchiul este brus: See a doctor if the knee is suddenly swollen, red, hot, if you have fever, if you cannot put weight on the leg, or after a blow/twist with instability. Calf pain with swelling, warmth or redness (especially after long trips, immobilization, surgery, or in pregnancy/after childbirth) may indicate thrombosis: emergency, do not massage the calf. If you take anticoagulants, avoid deep pressure. Do not press over severe varicose veins.
Mergi la medic dacă simptomele persistă: See a doctor if the symptoms persist after descending, occur with chest pain, dizziness with slurred speech or weakness, persistent vomiting, or if they are severe and frequent. Severe chest pain, or chest pain with sweating, shortness of breath or pain radiating to the arm/jaw is an emergency: call 112.
Mergi la medic dacă sugarul are: febră d: See a doctor if the infant has: fever of 38 °C or more, severe diarrhea, vomiting, rashes on the body, refusal to feed, lethargy, inconsolable crying. These symptoms are not automatically attributed to teething.
Mergi la medic dacă sughițul durează pes: See a doctor if hiccups last more than 48 hours, prevent you from eating or sleeping, occur with chest pain, difficulty speaking, weakness, or after a stroke. Persistent hiccups with chest or abdominal pain may signal a serious condition. Severe chest pain, or chest pain with sweating, shortness of breath or pain radiating to the arm/jaw is an emergency: call 112.
Mergi la medic dacă transpirațiile sunt: See a doctor if the sweating is nocturnal and profuse, occurs with fever, weight loss, palpitations, chest pain, or appears suddenly in adulthood, or is associated with new medications. Severe chest pain, or chest pain with sweating, shortness of breath or pain radiating to the arm/jaw is an emergency: call 112.
Mergi la medic dacă: durerea este severă: See a doctor if: the pain is severe or new after age 25, very heavy bleeding (changing a pad or tampon more often than every 1–2 hours), fever, abnormal discharge, pain outside the cycle, a delayed period with intense pain (possible ectopic pregnancy: emergency), dizziness or fainting. Pain that progressively worsens, pain during sexual intercourse or difficulty getting pregnant may signal endometriosis. Sudden pelvic pain with fainting or shoulder pain: emergency 112.
Mergi la medic de urgență la: slăbiciune: Go to a doctor urgently for: weakness or numbness in the leg, numbness in the buttock/groin area, loss of bladder or bowel control, fever, pain after an accident, night pain that does not subside, unexplained weight loss, history of cancer. Emergency: intense and sudden low back pain with abdominal pain, fainting or sweating (possible aortic aneurysm or another serious event), or low back pain with fever, burning on urination or blood in the urine. New onset after age 50, osteoporosis, long-term corticosteroids or anticoagulants: medical evaluation before deep pressure. In pregnancy do not use lumbosacral acupressure (BL23, BL25, GV4) and GB30; low back pain in pregnancy should be discussed with the doctor.
Mergi la medic de urgență la: vărsături: Go to a doctor urgently for: vomiting blood or a "coffee grounds" appearance, intense abdominal pain, high fever, signs of dehydration, vomiting persisting beyond 24 hours (beyond 12 hours in children), severe headache or stiff neck, chest pain, pregnancy with repeated vomiting. Do not use acupressure to delay a consultation if you have intense abdominal pain, especially in the lower right, with fever (possible appendicitis). Severe chest pain, or chest pain with sweating, shortness of breath or pain radiating to the arm/jaw is an emergency: call 112.
Mergi la medic/psiholog dacă ai epuizare: See a doctor/psychologist if you have persistent exhaustion, depressive symptoms, thoughts of harming yourself (112), increased alcohol or sedative use, persistent physical symptoms (palpitations, chest pain). Severe chest pain, or chest pain with sweating, shortness of breath or pain radiating to the arm/jaw is an emergency: call 112.
Mergi la medic/psiholog dacă anxietatea: See a doctor/psychologist if anxiety affects your work and relationships, you have repeated panic attacks, palpitations with chest pain, thoughts of harming yourself or of suicide (call 112 immediately; do not stay alone and talk to someone you trust). Stop the technique if dizziness or worsening anxiety occurs. Do not replace prescribed treatment. Severe chest pain, or chest pain with sweating, shortness of breath or pain radiating to the arm/jaw is an emergency: call 112.
Mergi la medic/stomatolog dacă maxilarul: See a doctor/dentist if the jaw locks, you cannot open your mouth, the pain appears after a blow, you have fever, swelling, chest pain, or pain radiating to the arm/neck (may be cardiac). Severe chest pain, or chest pain with sweating, shortness of breath or pain radiating to the arm/jaw is an emergency: call 112.
Mergi urgent la medic ORL la: tinitus br: See an ENT doctor urgently for: sudden tinnitus with hearing loss in one ear (an emergency in the first 24–72 hours), pulsatile tinnitus, severe dizziness, facial weakness, after noise or head trauma, new unilateral tinnitus. Thoughts of harming yourself because of the ringing: call 112.
Mergi urgent la medic dacă ai: febră, fr: See a doctor urgently if you have: fever, chills, low back or flank pain (possible kidney infection), blood in the urine, vomiting, pregnancy with urinary symptoms, symptoms in men or children. An untreated urinary infection can spread to the kidneys; in diabetics, the immunocompromised and the elderly, the consultation should not be delayed.
Meridianele yin ale mâinii (LU, PC, HT): The yin meridians of the hand (LU, PC, HT) run along the inner side of the arm; the yang ones of the hand (LI, TE, SI) along the outer side. The yin meridians of the foot (SP, LR, KI) run along the inner side of the lower limb; the yang ones (ST, GB, BL) along the outer, anterior, lateral or posterior side. Each yin meridian is paired with a yang one, as a related "pair": LU–LI, ST–SP, HT–SI, BL–KI, PC–TE, GB–LR. The pairings also appear in the logic of the Luo and Yuan points, which you will meet in the lesson "Special types of points".
Migrenă și cefalee: acupunctura este men: Migraine and headache: acupuncture is mentioned in some guidelines as an option for prophylaxis; the British NICE guideline for headache (CG150) suggests, as far as we know, considering a course of acupuncture for the prophylaxis of migraine and chronic tension-type headache. Check the current version. In 2025 a Cochrane protocol appeared for the prophylaxis of episodic migraine with acupuncture; it does not yet have results.
Mișcare regulată, somn, reducerea sării,: Regular exercise, sleep, reducing salt, caffeine and alcohol before menstruation, regular meals, relaxation techniques, a symptom diary. In pregnancy, omit CV6 (lower abdomen).
Moxibustia folosește frunze de Artemisia: Moxibustion uses Artemisia (mugwort) leaves burned near the points. Traditionally, it is said to "warm the meridians" and expel "cold". Types: direct moxa (a small cone on the skin, which can leave a scar and is rarely practiced), indirect moxa (with a layer of ginger, garlic or salt between the cone and the skin), the moxa stick held above the skin, and box moxa. The main risk is burns, followed by smoke, which can irritate the airways; the space must be ventilated. It is avoided in case of fever, on damaged skin, on the face, in pregnancy (abdominal area) and in people with reduced sensitivity. Evidence: there are studies for some situations, such as turning a fetus from breech presentation, but the quality is low or variable, and the practice is done only under obstetric supervision, not at home.
Mușchi tensionați în zona umerilor: Tense muscles in the shoulder area
Mușchii spatelui, de o parte și de alta: The back muscles, on either side of the spine
Mărturia unor pacienți mulțumiți de trat: The testimony of patients satisfied with the treatment
NICE o recomandă, iar ACP o respinge: NICE recommends it, and ACP rejects it
Niciodată; durerea face parte din tratam: Never; pain is part of the treatment
Nu folosi acest protocol în sarcină sau: Do not use this protocol in pregnancy or if your period is late and pregnancy has not been excluded (SP6, SP8, CV4 and the lumbosacral area are avoided in tradition). Severe or new pain, heavy bleeding or fever: consult a doctor.
Nu masa și nu apăsa zona; întreabă medic: Do not massage or press the area; ask the doctor.
Nu pe tumoră, ganglioni sau zone iradiat: Not on the tumor, lymph nodes or irradiated areas; no needles on the limb with lymphedema; it does not replace oncological treatment; risk of infection in neutropenia (discuss with the oncologist).
Nu scutura niciodată sugarul, nici în mo: Never shake the infant, not even in moments of exhaustion: put them safely in the crib and breathe. Go urgently to a doctor/112 if the infant has: fever (38 °C or more under 3 months), greenish or bloody vomit, a swollen and hard abdomen, bloody stool, lethargy, refusal to feed, unusual inconsolable crying, difficulty breathing, a bulging fontanelle.
O acupunctură mai profundă, cu mai multe: A deeper acupuncture, with more needles
Obligatorie în orice studiu clinic serio: Mandatory in any serious clinical trial
Ochii la ecran: oboseala vizuală include: Eyes on the screen: visual fatigue includes dryness, tension around the eyes and mild headache. Traditional points: BL2, at the inner end of the eyebrow, ST2, below the eye, on the edge of the bone, and GB14, above the eyebrow. Press gently, only with the fingertip, without touching the eyeball. In schools in China there is a series of eye exercises; the evidence for eye acupressure is limited and small, so treat it as a relaxation break. The 20-20-20 rule (every 20 minutes, look at something 6 meters away for 20 seconds) is a common recommendation, with modest evidence but without risks.
Odihnă progresivă, hidratare, alimentați: Progressive rest, hydration, a diet rich in protein and vegetables, short walks that gradually lengthen, sleep, gradual return to routine. In pregnancy, omit SP6. In pregnancy, omit CV6 (lower abdomen).
PC6 este punctul cel mai studiat pentru: PC6 is the most studied point for nausea (low to moderate quality evidence, mainly after surgery). Press on both wrists; acupressure wristbands have equally limited evidence. In pregnancy ask a doctor for advice, and CV12 is avoided. Repeated vomiting, fever or severe abdominal pain: medical consultation.
PC6 este punctul cu cele mai multe studi: PC6 is the point with the most studies: the 2015 Cochrane review (Lee et al.) shows a modest effect on postoperative nausea and vomiting versus simulation, but no additional benefit over antiemetic medication; for chemotherapy-induced nausea and other causes the evidence is weaker and inconsistent.
Pachete cu ace, folosite pentru înțepare: Packets of needles, used for puncturing
Paul Nogier a lucrat la Lyon; hărțile au: Paul Nogier worked in Lyon; the modern auricular maps, formulated in the mid-1950s, are attributed to him.
Pe dosul mâinii, între metacarpienele II: On the back of the hand, between the second and third metacarpals
Pe dosul piciorului, între metatarsienel: On the top of the foot, between the first and second metatarsals
Pe o fișă, scrie cele patru perechi (opt: On a sheet, write the four pairs (eight points) of opening points (SP4–PC6, SI3–BL62, TE5–GB41, LU7–KI6) and, next to each point, the name of the meridian it lies on. Memorize them two by two. It is a professional vocabulary exercise.
Pe palma unei mâini cu piele intactă: On the palm of a hand with intact skin
Pe talpa unui picior fără semne de infla: On the sole of a foot with no signs of inflammation
Pe talpă, în depresiunea de la flexia de: On the sole, in the depression at the flexion of the toes
Pe un picior sănătos, fără umflătură sau: On a healthy foot, without swelling or pain
Pe vârful nasului, în centrul lui: On the tip of the nose, in its center
Pentru PC6 și greața postoperatorie dove: For PC6 and postoperative nausea the evidence is of low to moderate quality. For the other points and conditions the results are mixed or limited.
Pentru a economisi ace și materiale de s: To save needles and study materials
Pentru a scurta durata totală a studiulu: To shorten the total duration of the study
Pentru a scădea costul tratamentului: To lower the cost of treatment
Pentru artroza de genunchi, o sinteză Co: For knee osteoarthritis, a Cochrane review (Manheimer et al., 2010) found small pain improvements, below the threshold of clinical relevance compared with sham acupuncture, and the NICE guideline NG226 (2022) does not recommend acupuncture for osteoarthritis. For acupressure the evidence is limited; the basis of treatment remains exercise, muscle strengthening and weight loss.
Pentru bufeuri (certitudine scăzută), ac: For hot flashes (low certainty), acupuncture has limited and inconsistent evidence; some studies show small improvements compared with no treatment, but less so compared with placebo acupuncture. Acupressure is a comfort adjunct.
Pentru care dintre aceste afecțiuni exis: For which of these conditions is there moderate-level evidence that acupuncture relieves pain?
Pentru ce tip de durere există dovezi de: For what type of pain is there moderate-quality evidence that acupuncture reduces the frequency of attacks (prophylaxis)?
Pentru că analiza statistică devine inut: Because the statistical analysis becomes useless
Pentru depresie, dovezile pentru acupunc: For depression, the evidence for acupuncture is of low quality and inconsistent; for acupressure alone there is no solid evidence. It does not replace psychotherapy or medical treatment.
Pentru dismenoreea primară, sintezele Co: For primary dysmenorrhea, the Cochrane reviews (Smith et al., 2011 and 2016) show low-certainty evidence that acupuncture and acupressure may reduce pain compared with no treatment, with small studies and risk of bias; analgesics (NSAIDs) and heat have more solid evidence.
Pentru durerea din artroza de genunchi,: For knee osteoarthritis pain, the effect compared with no treatment is moderate, but compared with sham it is small and often below the clinical threshold.
Pentru fibromialgie, o sinteză Cochrane: For fibromyalgia, a Cochrane review (Deare et al., 2013) found low- to moderate-certainty evidence that electroacupuncture relieves pain and stiffness, but not that manual acupuncture is better than sham acupuncture. Gentle aerobic exercise and tai chi have more consistent evidence; acupressure is mainly a relaxation adjunct.
Pentru greața din sarcină, revizuirea Co: For nausea in pregnancy, the Cochrane review (Matthews et al., 2015) shows low-quality, inconsistent evidence for PC6 acupressure; a clear benefit over sham has not been demonstrated. Safety is considered good for PC6 in the existing studies, but their number is small.
Pentru insomnie, sintezele existente ara: For insomnia, the existing reviews show low-certainty evidence regarding sleep quality after acupuncture, with a high risk of bias; for acupressure, small studies show modest improvements. Cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia (CBT-I) is the first-line treatment (ACP 2016, AASM).
Pentru lombalgia cronică, o sinteză Coch: For chronic low back pain, a Cochrane review (Mu et al., 2020) shows that acupuncture (with needles) reduces pain compared with no treatment (moderate certainty), but compared with sham acupuncture the difference is small, below the threshold of clinical relevance (low certainty). The NICE guideline NG59 does not recommend acupuncture for low back pain; other guidelines (ACP 2017) include it as a non-pharmacological option. For acupressure alone the evidence is weaker; it may bring relaxation and comfort alongside movement and exercise.
Pentru profilaxia migrenei, acupunctura: For migraine prophylaxis, acupuncture has moderate-level evidence (Cochrane reviews) for reducing the frequency of attacks, at least similar in some studies to preventive medication, but with low-quality evidence; for acupressure the evidence is limited.
Pentru rinita alergică, sinteza Cochrane: For allergic rhinitis, the Cochrane review (Feng et al., 2015) suggests a benefit of acupuncture, but with low- to moderate-certainty evidence, and the difference compared with sham acupuncture is uncertain; for acupressure the evidence is limited. It is not an alternative to antiallergic treatment.
Pentru unele simptome (ex. greață, durer: For some symptoms (e.g. nausea, pain) the evidence is limited to moderate; there is no evidence that acupuncture cures or prevents cancer.
Piele sănătoasă, intactă, pe mușchii spa: Healthy, intact skin over the back muscles
Poate înlocui chimioterapia în stadiile: It can replace chemotherapy in the early stages
Poate înlocui insulina la persoanele cu: It can replace insulin in people with diabetes
Pot vindeca alergiile prin frecvențe: They can cure allergies through frequencies
Poziție culcat, sesiuni scurte; întreabă: Lying position, short sessions; ask your doctor.
Poziții de ținut în brațe, eructație, su: Holding positions in the arms, burping, monotone sound, loose swaddling only on the back and only until the infant starts to roll over (not for sleep after that), avoiding overstimulation, checking the feeding technique, pediatric consultation.
Poți combina cu înclinări lente ale capu: You can combine it with slow head tilts. Avoid strong pressure on the side of the neck (arteries). Omit LI4 and GB21 in pregnancy. Numbness or pain going down the arm, weakness or dizziness: seek medical advice.
Precauții generale: presiune ușoară până: General precautions: light to moderate pressure, no sharp pain, 30–60 seconds, no more than a few minutes; not on damaged, inflamed or varicose skin; caution in pregnancy (LI4, SP6, and in tradition sometimes also GB21 or BL60), with anticoagulants and in chronic diseases. Do not use the points to postpone medical consultation for new symptoms. If dizziness, nausea or increasing pain occur, stop.
Presiune cu degetele mari sau cu o minge: Pressure with the thumbs or with a tennis ball next to the spine; never directly on the spine. Omit BL60 in pregnancy and ask for the doctor's approval for the lumbosacral area. Pain going down the leg, weakness, saddle numbness, loss of bladder or bowel control, fever or pain after trauma: emergency.
Presiune foarte ușoară, 20–30 s, pe BL2: Very light pressure, 20–30 s, on BL2 and around the orbit (not on the eyeball), then GB20 and LI4 for 30–60 s. Wash your hands beforehand; do not massage if you wear lenses, have an eye infection, glaucoma, recent eye surgery or high myopia with a risk of retinal detachment.
Presiune moale pe lateralele nasului (LI: Soft pressure on the sides of the nose (LI20); do not insert your fingers into the nostrils. Omit LI4 in pregnancy. Fever, intense facial pain or symptoms lasting more than 10 days: seek medical advice.
Presiune ușoară-medie; omite LI4 în sarc: Light to medium pressure; omit LI4 in pregnancy. For persistent toothache, facial swelling or fever, go to the dentist.
Presiunea puternică pe o zonă cu posibil: Strong pressure on an area with a possible thrombus can dislodge the clot; a painful, warm and swollen area requires medical evaluation.
Previne apariția cancerului la persoanel: Prevents cancer from developing in healthy people

Punctele He mare (He-Sea) sunt situate d: The He-Sea points are usually located near the elbow or knee (for example LI11 and HT3 at the elbow). Those on the leg, called "Lower He" points, are traditionally linked to the Fu organs: ST36 (Stomach), GB34 (Gallbladder), BL40 (Bladder). The Hui (Influential) points are eight places that "gather" certain tissues or substances: CV12 for the Fu organs, CV17 for Qi, BL17 for blood, GB34 for tendons and muscles, BL11 for bones, GB39 for marrow, LU9 for vessels and LR13 for the Zang organs.

Redu lichidele și cafeaua seara, ridică: Reduce fluids and coffee in the evening, raise your legs during the day if you have swelling, avoid alcohol, discuss medication and sleep apnea with your doctor. In pregnancy omit CV4 (lower abdomen).
Regula 20-20-20 este o recomandare uzual: The 20-20-20 rule is a common recommendation, with modest evidence but no risks.
Reguli de prudență: evită pielea lezată,: Rules of caution: avoid damaged, inflamed or rash-affected skin, visible varicose veins, areas with recent bruises and operated areas, as well as areas with venous thrombosis, recent fractures or tumors. In young children and frail elderly people the pressure remains very gentle. Do not press hard on the abdomen after a meal or in pregnancy without medical advice; some points (for example LI4, SP6) are avoided in pregnancy in tradition. Stop if dizziness, persistent numbness or increasing pain occur. Acupressure is comfort care and does not replace medical evaluation for new, intense or persistent symptoms.
Respirația face jumătate din tehnică. In: Breathing is half of the technique. Inhale through the nose for a few seconds, and on the long exhalation increase the pressure slightly; on the next exhalation hold it. Calm breathing lowers muscle tension and makes the sensation easier to bear. In TCM tradition, slow exhalation helps "Qi to circulate"; in the modern explanation, slow breathing may favor activation of the parasympathetic system, and attention to the sensation may change pain perception.
Respirația lentă poate scădea tensiunea: Slow breathing may lower tension and favor the parasympathetic response; TCM describes it in terms of Qi, but the practical benefit is relaxation.

Somn regulat de 7–9 ore, mișcare zilnică: Regular sleep of 7–9 hours, daily movement, hydration, balanced meals, natural light, limiting alcohol, checking blood tests with your doctor (anemia, thyroid). In pregnancy omit SP6. In pregnancy omit CV6 (lower abdomen).
Somn suficient, activitate fizică regula: Sufficient sleep, regular physical activity, varied diet, vitamin D as recommended by the doctor, hand hygiene, recommended vaccinations, stress management. In pregnancy omit CV6 (lower abdomen).
Stimularea percutană a nervului tibial p: Percutaneous posterior tibial nerve stimulation (PTNS), a medical procedure using a device, has moderate-level evidence for reducing urgency; this is not the same as acupressure. For acupressure alone the evidence is limited.
Straturi de îmbrăcăminte, cameră răcoroa: Layers of clothing, cool room, avoiding alcohol and spices, regular movement, sleep, discuss treatment options with your doctor. In pregnancy omit SP6.
Studiile arată că precizia localizării v: Studies show that the accuracy of point location varies between practitioners, and differences of a few millimeters are common. Some studies also suggest that the measured effects depend less on an exact point than on the area stimulated and the type of stimulus, but the question remains open. This calls for methodological modesty, not negligence: in a course, we strive to locate correctly, but we do not claim millimeter exactness.
Studiile despre acupunctură în sciatalgi: Studies on acupuncture for sciatica are of variable quality, with limited evidence; the NICE guideline NG59 does not recommend it for low back pain with or without sciatica. Acupressure is at most a comfort adjunct.
Studiile despre acupunctură/acupresură î: Studies on acupuncture/acupressure for colic are of low quality and the results are inconsistent; needles are not recommended in infants. A review of studies with acupuncture for colic shows inconsistent results. Gentle massage may soothe, but it is not a proven treatment.

TENS (stimulare electrică nervoasă trans: TENS (transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation) uses electrodes on the skin and low currents for pain. TEAS is the variant applied to acupuncture points. For TENS the evidence is mixed: some studies support benefits for pain, especially in certain conditions, but the quality of the studies is variable and the effect may be small. For TEAS, studies in the perioperative period and in other contexts are promising but heterogeneous. Contraindications: pacemaker, epilepsy (especially on the head/neck), pregnancy (specific regions), damaged skin, areas with tumors, the region of the heart and neck, areas with loss of sensation.

Un pas important a fost Zhenjiu Jiayijin: An important step was the Zhenjiu Jiayijing ("The Systematic A–B Classic of Acupuncture and Moxibustion"), compiled by Huangfu Mi in the second half of the 3rd century AD (c. 256–282). The author reorganized the older material into a systematic structure of points, locations and indications. It became a reference for centuries, and the locations in it decisively influenced the later tradition.
Un protocol de acupresură este o succesi: An acupressure protocol is a short sequence of points, chosen according to a purpose. Here you see four of the protocols in PUNCTUM. They are comfort suggestions, not medical treatments: if the symptom is strong, new or does not go away, seek medical advice.

Dizziness with bleeding (including heavy menstrual bleeding), in pregnancy or with palpitations requires evaluation. See a doctor if the dizziness is recurrent, with vertigo or reduced hearing. Intense chest pain, or chest pain with sweating, shortness of breath or radiating pain to the arm/jaw is an emergency: call 112.
Urgență 112: cea mai gravă cefalee din v: Emergency 112: the worst headache of your life or with sudden onset, new or prolonged aura, weakness or numbness on one side, speech disturbances, fever with stiff neck, after trauma, seizures. Urgență 112: cefalee bruscă și severă („: Emergency 112: sudden and severe headache ("the worst of your life"), with fever and stiff neck, after trauma, with confusion, double vision, weakness, speech disturbances or seizures. It is also an emergency in the case of headache triggered by cough/exertion/sexual activity, with a skin rash with spots that do not fade on pressure, with a painful red eye and blurred vision, or in pregnancy/after childbirth with high blood pressure. Temple tenderness, pain when chewing or vision disturbances after age 50 may be temporal arteritis (risk of blindness): emergency. See a doctor if the headache is new after age 50, progressive, wakes you from sleep or changes your usual pattern.
Urgență 112: dificultate severă de respi: Emergency 112: severe difficulty breathing, inability to speak in sentences, bluish lips, no response to rescue medication, confusion or exhaustion. Do not use acupressure during an attack. See a doctor if you need your rescue inhaler more often than usual or you wake at night with symptoms.
Urgență 112: durere cervicală bruscă și: Emergency 112: sudden and severe neck pain, especially after sudden neck movements or manipulations (possible artery dissection), or with a drooping face, slurred speech or weakness on one side (possible stroke); neck pain after trauma or a fall, pain with fever and stiff neck, sudden severe headache, weakness or tingling in the arm/hand, vision or speech disturbances, severe dizziness, chest pain. Do not force "cracking" maneuvers of the neck. In pregnancy omit GB21. Intense chest pain, or chest pain with sweating, shortness of breath or radiating pain to the arm/jaw is an emergency: call 112.
Urgență: durere abdominală intensă sau u: Emergency: intense or one-sided abdominal pain, vaginal bleeding, fainting (possible ectopic pregnancy), severe headache with vision disturbances, vomiting blood. See a doctor if: repeated vomiting that does not allow hydration, weight loss, little dark-colored urine, dizziness, abdominal pain, bleeding, fever. Hyperemesis gravidarum requires medical treatment.
Urgență: durere de umăr cu durere toraci: Emergency: shoulder pain with chest pain, dyspnea or sweating (possibly cardiac), after a fall with deformity, fever, red and warm shoulder, sudden loss of arm strength, drooping face or slurred speech (possible stroke: 112). Pain in the left shoulder or with a feeling of pressure in the chest may be cardiac: do not massage it, call 112. See a doctor also if the pain persists for more than a few weeks or wakes you at night.
Ventuzele (cupping) creează vid, care ri: Cupping creates a vacuum that slightly lifts the skin and tissues. A distinction is made between dry cupping (static, gliding) and wet cupping (hijama), where small superficial incisions are made and a little blood is drawn. The circular marks are ecchymoses (blood leaked under the skin), not open wounds, but they can last days or weeks; cupping is not applied on damaged skin, with anticoagulants, in pregnancy (abdomen and lumbar area) or on young children. Wet cupping involves a risk of infection, including transmission of blood-borne viruses, if the instruments are not sterile, so only with professionals who maintain strict hygiene. The evidence for pain is of low quality and affected by the lack of a credible sham control.

În 1822 (al doilea an al domniei Daoguan: In 1822 (the second year of the Daoguang reign) acupuncture and moxibustion were removed from the Imperial Academy of Medicine; they remained in popular practice. The exact reasons are debated by historians.
În aplicație vei vedea mereu aceeași dis: In the app you will always see the same distinction: what tradition says and what studies support. Modern evidence is of low to moderate quality for some chronic pains (low back, headache, migraine) and for postoperative nausea, and the benefits are generally small; for knee osteoarthritis the difference compared with sham is small and often below the threshold of clinical relevance. For many other conditions the evidence is weak or contradictory. Studies with "sham acupuncture" often show small differences compared with real acupuncture, which suggests that part of the benefit comes from the context: attention, ritual, expectation and relaxation. This effect is real for the person who experiences it, but it should not be confused with a specific mechanism of the points.
